title: Choose a video model
summary: Pick the right connected model for each shot from its declared inputs, length and cost, and handle failed or uncertain jobs without paying twice.
author: Viral Hit contributors

inputs.label: Shot to make
inputs.description: What the shot shows, its length, aspect ratio and which images or video it must follow.

inputs.label: Budget and model limits
inputs.description: Any model or service the user pinned, excluded, or a spending cap.

stages.title: Select a model
stages.description: Match the shot to models whose declared inputs and lengths fit.

stages.title: Submit
stages.description: Prepare, show the request and cost, then submit once.

stages.title: Recover
stages.description: Handle confirmed failures within the approved retry budget and reconcile unknown outcomes.
